objections.claim: The runtime/install contract is internally contradictory and would mislead operators. Section 1 makes `--disable-sigusr1` a prerequisite, sets PYLAE's floor to Node >=22.14.0, and requires doctor/install to refuse 22.12.x–22.13.x; it also refuses versions above the capability registry's reviewed ceiling. Section 4 nevertheless specifies the installation contract as `Node >=22.12`, an unbounded range that includes both known-refused lower versions and unreviewed future versions. Replace every operator-facing runtime claim and manifest range with the actual bounded supported interval `[22.14.0, reviewed ceiling]` (or supply a sound alternative containment mechanism), and add regressions proving 22.12.x/22.13.x, the upper boundary, and above-ceiling versions agree across engines, launcher, doctor, install docs, and the Node-version reconciliation oracle.
